rule: fem_a1 promoted by the team on test day 2026-10-04; ensembles removed from the menu. Confidence high iff the site is not out-of-distribution for the fem_a1 fingerprint model and its call agrees with at least 2 of the 3 menu options (fingerprint, fingerprint_centred, patch).
menu_option_rule: max LOPO expected rubric among the 3 remaining menu options (fingerprint_centred 1.000, fingerprint 0.912, patch 0.794; outputs/menu/menu_evaluation.json)

previous_selection.rule: max LOPO expected rubric with the option's flag rule (ties: fewer components, then menu order)

fem_a1.description: Leo 16 fingerprint features + swell_resid + si_stress_spread from free-lateral FEM (right edge free)
fem_a1.cv: leave-one-parent-out (parent_id from pmdb.parents.parent_groups), 34 labelled sites incl. the 3 held-out sites with organiser truths; same protocol as the other menu options
fem_a1.lopo_a0_correct_check: 16/34, identical to the menu 'fingerprint' option (0.471), so the A1 number is protocol-comparable
fem_a1.rubric: not computed: A1 has no confidence-flag rule in the menu, so it is not ranked by rubric
fem_a1.superseded_site_loo: 24/31 leave-one-site-out (balanced acc 0.695, perm p 0.001) had sibling crops of the same parent in training; do not compare with menu numbers
fem_a1.produced_by: python scripts/fem_a1_lopo.py (LOPO); python scripts/fem_fingerprint_eval.py --fem-site-curves outputs/fem/free_lateral/site_curves.csv --tag main (site-LOO, superseded)
